reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 a reference-modified operand is an elementary item without JUSTIFIED; a reference-modified function is class and category alphanumeric; a reference-modified data-name keeps the class and category of data-name-1 (alphabetic stays alphabetic, a group becomes an elementary alphanumeric) except that numeric, numeric edited and alphanumeric edited become alphanumeric, which governs MOVE (no editing, no decimal alignment, no justification, the Table of category bars), comparison (nonnumeric) and class tests.

edition-consulted.switches: ClassConditionModel.RulesAt(DialectLevel): the 1985 class-condition operand rule set (NUMERIC not over an alphabetic item, COBOL6917) instead of the 2002+ set; the alphabetic fact it reads is the edition-agnostic MoveTable16.SenderPosition rider, so a refmod alphabetic slice is refused

reader.edition-search: grep -n -E 'Edition|CobolVersion|Std|Dialect|Construct' over Place.cs, MoveClassifier.cs, MoveTable16.cs, OperandText.cs found no edition test: the GR5 category reader RefModPlace.CategoryOf, the MOVE classifier and the comparison text predicate are one code for every edition; the only edition arm on the path is the class-condition rule set.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the category rewrite is the same at 85 and 2023 for every 1985 category (2023 adds national/boolean arms 1985 has no items for); probe rm5pos printed identical lines at --std 85 and --std 2023. Only the class-condition operand bars differ by edition (a separate rule).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise numeric refmod compared as characters and the NUMERIC test on an alphabetic slice; not exercised by them: JUSTIFIED dropped on a refmod receiver, numeric-edited and alphanumeric-edited receivers (no editing), group refmod as an elementary item, the MOVE category bars over an alphabetic slice, function refmod as alphanumeric (probed here).

reader.notes: RefModPlace.CategoryOf rewrites numeric and numeric-edited to alphanumeric and preserves every other category; alphanumeric edited has no PicCategory of its own and loses its edit mask through Table16Operand.Of(Place), and the alphabetic rider survives, which is exactly GR5's exception list. The refmod receiver is never a group and carries no JUSTIFIED (store through the slice place). Every probe matched the text.
